description: Read-only. Given a Mizan agent_id (and optionally a category), return a plain verdict from its PUBLIC Mizan passport: no_record (nothing logged), provisional (fewer than 50 resolved answers in a category, indicative only) or rated (50 or more), plus calibration warning flags and what the verdict does not cover. It reads existing data and writes nothing. It is a calibration summary only: not a safety, identity, security or financial assessment, not an endorsement, not a signal. Flag thresholds other than the 50-answer gate are QANTS proposals.

category.description: Optional. math_crypto, history, science, future_event or trap. Omit for all categories combined.

name: trust_check
title: Mizan trust check (read-only)
